div.head: Abt 32
div.ab: Gif man rihthamscyld þurhstinð, mid weorðe forgelde.
Gif man rihthamscyld þurh stinð, mid weorðe forgelde.
If a person pierces through the rihthamscyld, let him pay with [its] worth.
If anyone damages the enclosure of a dwelling, he shall pay according to its value.
If anyone thrusts through a true hamscyld, he is to pay for it with its value.
Wenn jemand rechten Heimschild durchsticht, entgelte er [dem Geschädigten] mit [dessen] Werthe.
If someone pierces through the proper home-shield, let him pay [the injured party] with [its] value.
div.note: This is obscure. Attcnborough suggests tentatively, “damages the enclosure of a dwelling”, see also Liebermann, Archiv für das Studium der neueren Sprachen, cxv, 389–91.
